# Vincent Hamel, CPA

> Montreal-based finance and management advisor (CPA) offering fractional CFO services to companies of every size: financing, governance, clear financial models, processes, custom management tools, transactions, cash management and growth. Decisions grounded in data and guided by business judgment. International practice, with experience mostly in Quebec, Canada and the United States. Works in English and French.

## Key facts
- Over 15 years leading finance and operations for growing companies, with teams of up to 1,000 employees.
- Chief Financial Officer of Felix & Paul Studios (Emmy-recognized immersive entertainment studio) from 2022 to 2026.
- VP Finance and Administration, previously Finance and Administration Director and Partner, at Sid Lee (global creative agency), 2011 to 2022.
- CPA; HEC Montréal.
- Builds financial models and dashboards that are easy to read and understand, giving leaders command of their numbers and giving boards, lenders and investors confidence.

## Services
- **Fractional CFO**: You need a CFO, without the full-time position. Executive-level financial leadership alongside the CEO and leadership team, at the pace that suits you.
- **Models and performance**: You want clear numbers to make decisions. I build financial models and dashboards that are easy to read and understand. You master your numbers and every decision rests on solid ground.
- **Financing**: You need to fund the next stage. I prepare the file, the model and the strategy, then negotiate with lenders or investors through to closing.
- **Governance**: Your partners want a clear view. Board, lenders, investors: clear reporting and credible forecasts that give them confidence and make every conversation easier.
- **Processes and growth**: Your growth has outpaced your processes. I put in place the processes, finance team and systems that keep up with the business.
- **Custom tools**: Your management tools no longer fit your needs. I develop custom solutions for your management tools: dashboards, automations, tracking and forecasting tools, built around the way you work and connected to your systems.
- **Transactions**: You are considering a transaction. Acquisition, sale, shareholder buyout or succession: valuation, structure, negotiation and coordination of your advisors through to signing.
- **Cash and turnaround**: Cash is getting tight. I take charge of cash, negotiate with financial partners and build a realistic turnaround plan.

## Engagements
Flexible and shaped around the needs of the company and its leaders: project mandate, ongoing advisory (a few days a month or a week), or interim.

## Approach
1. Diagnosis: read the numbers, meet the team, identify what matters.
2. Plan: easy-to-read models, costed options, candid recommendations.
3. Delivery: negotiations, implementation and follow-through until results are achieved.
